please_complete_profile: Please complete your profile and ensure you show up in search:
fill_in_who_i_am: 1. Fill in your "Who I am" section with a few sentences about yourself
upload_photo: 2. Upload a photo (by clicking on the avatar on the edit page)
complete_profile_explanation: Don't you hate how other platforms have empty "ghost" profiles with no information. Please don't ghost us! 👻👻👻
no_community: You are not currently in a community.
landing_text: We are building new <featuresLink>features</featuresLink> like events, local guides, moderation and hangouts. We appreciate your patience and <supportLink>support</supportLink> as we develop these.
your_communities_helper_text: You have been added to all communities based on your location. Feel free to <browseCommunitiesLink>browse communities</browseCommunitiesLink> in other locations as well.
your_communities_helper_text2: Don't see your community? <requestCommunityLink>Get it started!</requestCommunityLink>
communities_intro: To help people around the world organize events, discussions, and meetups locally, we created community pages, which are listed below. You have automatically been added to some communities based on your location, but you can join any community! Your communities are listed on the dashboard.
community_builder: Want to be an ambassador for your community and help it grow? Become a <communityBuilderLink>Community Builder!</communityBuilderLink>
find_your_community_intro: Below you can search or browse all community pages that exist so far. Is your country or city missing? <requestCommunityLink>Use this form</requestCommunityLink> to request it!
find_your_community_intro_simplified: Search for your community or browse below. <requestCommunityLink>Don't see yours? Request it!</requestCommunityLink>
browse_communities_text: Click on a region name to see the other communities within it below. Click on link to go to that city or region's community page.
all_communities_intro: Below you can browse all community pages that exist so far. Click on a community name to see the other communities within it.
community_missing: Is your country or city missing? Use <requestCommunityLink>this form </requestCommunityLink> to request it!
